def can_grow_rice(x, y, heights):
    rows = len(heights)
    cols = len(heights[0])
    water_collected = [[0] * cols for _ in range(rows)]

    # Initialize the boundary cells with the maximum possible water they can hold
    for i in range(rows):
        water_collected[i][0] = heights[i][0]
        water_collected[i][cols - 1] = heights[i][cols - 1]
    for j in range(cols):
        water_collected[0][j] = heights[0][j]
        water_collected[rows - 1][j] = heights[rows - 1][j]

    # Propagate the water collected to adjacent cells
    for i in range(1, rows - 1):
        for j in range(1, cols - 1):
            water_collected[i][j] = max(heights[i][j], min(water_collected[i-1][j], water_collected[i+1][j], water_collected[i][j-1], water_collected[i][j+1]) - heights[i][j])

    # Calculate the total water collected
    total_water_collected = 0
    for i in range(rows):
        for j in range(cols):
            total_water_collected += water_collected[i][j]

    return total_water_collected
